articles.title: Xi Jinping pronuncia discurso en reunión conmemorativa por 105º aniversario de fundación del PCCh
articles.summary: Xi Jinping delivered a speech at a commemorative meeting marking the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China.

articles.title: Xi pide adoptar medidas sólidas para modernizar agricultura y zonas rurales
articles.summary: Xi Jinping called for concrete measures to advance the modernization of agriculture and rural areas during an inspection tour.

articles.title: Xi insta a miembros del PCCh a llevar adelante las tradiciones revolucionarias
articles.summary: Xi Jinping urged Party members to carry forward revolutionary traditions in a response letter to a 102-year-old Party member.
